# NORTHÉ | Luxury Private Tours & Experiences Portugal

> Official website: https://www.northetours.com
> RNAAT License: 284/2026 (Turismo de Portugal)
> Base Location: Porto, Portugal (Co-ordinates: 41.1579, -8.6291)
> Primary Service Areas: Porto, Douro Valley, Minho, Braga, Guimarães, Aveiro, Northern Portugal & Galicia
> Operations: 100% Private tailor-made tours, premium executive vehicle fleet, certified wine guides & sommelier-chauffeurs.

## About NORTHÉ
NORTHÉ is an elite private tour operator based in Porto, Portugal. We curate bespoke, high-end travel experiences across Northern Portugal and the Douro Valley wine region. Every journey is 100% private (closed parties of 1 to 8 guests), featuring a modern executive fleet, certified local guides, hand-picked boutique winery visits, and private boat cruises.

## Core Tour Offerings
- **Douro Valley Wine Experience**: Full-day private tour featuring 2 premium Quinta visits, DOC Douro & Vintage Port tastings, traditional gourmet lunch, and a 1-hour scenic Rabelo river cruise in Pinhão. Starting at €420.
- **Porto Highlights & Heritage**: Comprehensive historic center private tour, Clérigos, Livraria Lello, São Bento, Gaia wine lodges, and panoramic views.
- **Minho Cultural Journey (Braga & Guimarães)**: UNESCO World Heritage sites, Bom Jesus do Monte sanctuary, and the birthplace of the Portuguese nation.
- **Aveiro & Costa Nova**: The Venice of Portugal with private Moliceiro boat canals and iconic striped fishermen houses.
- **Gerês National Park Safari**: Pristine waterfalls, mountain viewpoints, and thermal springs in Portugal's only national park.
- **Santiago de Compostela**: Trans-border pilgrimage and heritage journey from Porto to Galicia.

## Key Features & Differentiators
- 100% Private closed groups only (no shared strangers).
- Hotel pickup and drop-off in Porto, Vila Nova de Gaia, and Douro Valley.
- Multilingual certified guides: Portuguese, English, French, Spanish, German.
- Direct booking with best rate guarantee and flexible cancellation up to 48 hours.
- Verified official tour operator licensed under RNAAT 284/2026 by Turismo de Portugal.
